combo_box.name: target_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Pick whose height to adjust: you, a resident, an animated object or a Ghost Studio clone. A * marks an avatar that already has a local offset.

slider.label: Hover height (everyone sees)
slider.name: HoverHeightSlider
slider.tool_tip: The real hover height: sent to the region, so everyone sees it. Only available for Me, and only on regions that support it.

button.name: btn_reset_hover
button.tool_tip: Reset hover height to 0 (sent to the region)

slider.label: Local offset (only you see)
slider.name: ClientHeightSlider
slider.tool_tip: Lifts or lowers this avatar on YOUR screen only. Never sent to the region, never saved: it is gone when you log out.

button.name: btn_reset_local_mini
button.tool_tip: Reset the selected avatar's local offset to 0

button.label: Reset
button.name: btn_reset_local
button.tool_tip: Set the selected avatar's local offset back to 0

button.label: Reset all
button.name: btn_reset_all_local
button.tool_tip: Clear the local offset of every avatar

check_box.label: Bind Camera view (covers hover height and local offset)
check_box.name: BindCameraCheck
